meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: Claude 会充当发布管理员:确认版本号类型(patch/minor/major)后,触发 GitHub Actions 发布 oh-my-opencode,直至成功,再核对 GitHub 发布页、npm 包和 Discord 公告。
howto.when: 当你说出 publish、release、deploy 等触发词,并给出版本号类型(patch/minor/major)时触发;若没给版本号类型,它会先停下来问你。

say.text: 发布最新代码,版本号类型用 minor
say.note: 会触发 GitHub Actions 发布并跟进到完成

say.text: 帮我发个 patch 版本,发布这次的 bug 修复
say.note: patch 表示向后兼容的小修复

say.text: 执行 npm publish,升级 major 版本
say.note: major 属破坏性变更,会生成新的 GitHub 发布

howto.what_en: Claude acts as release manager: confirms the bump (patch/minor/major), triggers the GitHub Actions workflow, follows it to success, then verifies GitHub release, npm packages, and Discord announcement. It never fixes code during publish.
howto.when_en: When the user says publish, release, or deploy (or similar triggers) while giving a version bump type (patch/minor/major). If no bump type is given, it stops and asks first.

say_en.text: Publish the latest code with a minor version bump.
say_en.note: It triggers the publish workflow and follows it through.

say_en.text: Cut a patch release for the bug fix we just shipped.
say_en.note: A patch is a small, backward-compatible fix.

say_en.text: Run npm publish and bump to a major version.
say_en.note: Major means breaking changes; a GitHub release is created.
